sloka: बाहुभ्याम् पीडितः तेन महाशैलो महात्मना ।ररास सिंह अभिहतो महान् मत्त इव द्विपः ॥४-६७-४३॥
transliteration: bāhubhyām pīḍitaḥ tena mahāśailo mahātmanā ।rarāsa siṁha abhihato mahān matta iva dvipaḥ ॥4-67-43॥

translations.english: The mighty, preeminent monkey who was equal to Indra in valour took a leap from the high peaks of the tall mountain, Mahendra৷৷
